trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Erik: The open sea is my gym! I swim the length of this route every morning.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Erik: Sunk without a trace. Another lap should clear my head.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Vincent: You ride, I swim. Let's see whose Pokémon are quicker in the water!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Vincent: My arms are tired, and so are my Pokémon. You win this one.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Jessica: My Goldeen follow me in a line wherever I swim. Aren't they lovely?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Jessica: Lovely isn't enough, is it? Come on, everyone, more practice.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Erica: Finneon's tail glows after dark. Swimming with it at night is like carrying a lantern!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Erica: We'll just float here a while and get our breath back.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Adrian: Watch out for Tentacool in these waters. They sting! ...Like this!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Adrian: Stung right back. Fair's fair, I suppose.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Katelyn: Sun, sea and a battle. What more could anyone ask for?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Katelyn: A win, maybe. A win would have been nice.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Claire: Floatzel and I race each other out here. It always wins, but I'm catching up!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Claire: Beaten by you as well. I really must swim faster.
